entries.text: You see one of Shady Sands' guards.
entries.source_text: You see one of Shady Sands' guards.

entries.text: Hey, I think you'd better be leaving. We don't want your kind here.
entries.source_text:
Hey, I think you'd better be leaving.
 We don't want your kind here.

entries.text: I can't believe that Tandi has disappeared. I hope you are going to find her. It would really hurt Aradesh if something bad happened to her.

entries.text: Thanks for returning Tandi. It's a good sign for the future, don't you think?

entries.text: That's a damn shame about Tandi. I hope Aradesh will be ok.

entries.text: Welcome, stranger. We don't see your kind often.

entries.text: Uh, thanks. Bye.

entries.text: Why not?

entries.text: Hnnng!

entries.text: Not so fast! This is a small community. We don't see strangers often, and we don't really need them if you get my meaning. If you don't have a good reason to be here, you'd better just keep moving.

entries.text: Hey, I ain't gonna hurt anybody.

entries.text: Uh.

entries.text: I wasn't saying that you was gonna. You'd just better leave us alone.

entries.text: I'll try not to make trouble.

entries.text: I'm sick and tired of your trash. Prepare to meet your maker.
entries.source_text: I'm sick and tired of your trash. Prepare to meet your maker.

entries.text: Look, Shady Sands don't need your kind from the Hub, or Junktown, or wherever you come from. We do pretty good by ourselves.

entries.text: The last trader from the Hub sold us a malfunctioning irrigation pump. We've had it with your dirty deals.

entries.text: You got it all wrong. I'm not like that.

entries.text: Yeah, right. So you say. Just don't get into any trouble, Ok?

entries.text: Well, maybe you aren't. You do seem a little different to me. I'll tell you what. You should go talk to Aradesh. He is in the center of town.
